name: setregid
description: setregid() sets the real and/or effective group ID of the calling process. Supplying a value of -1 for either ID leaves it unchanged. It has restrictions for unprivileged processes, allowing only certain changes based on the real, effective, or saved set-group-ID.

parameters.name: rgid
parameters.description: The new real group ID, or -1 to leave unchanged

parameters.name: egid
parameters.description: The new effective group ID, or -1 to leave unchanged

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: The call would change the caller’s real GID, but there was a temporary failure allocating kernel data structures or it would exceed resource limits.
One or more of the target group IDs is not valid in this user namespace.
The calling process is not privileged and an invalid change was specified.

versions: Available since Linux 1.1.37, with 32-bit support from Linux 2.4
